Full-screen hide rule lives in build.py EXTRA_CSS and never hides Google-injected elements. */
/* Prototype: everything lives inside #k101. No body-hiding rules (lesson from first article). */
#k101{--ink:#0B1B33;--ink2:#142848;--blue:#1F6FB8;--sky:#9CD4E5;--coral:#F0604C;--yellow:#FFC86B;--paper:#F6F3EC;--line:rgba(11,27,51,.12);
  font-family:"Inter Tight","Pretendard",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);overflow-x:hidden;overflow-x:clip;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
#k101 *{box-sizing:border-box}
#k101[data-lang=ko]{font-family:"Pretendard","Inter Tight",system-ui,sans-serif;word-break:keep-all}
[data-lang=ko] .k-h1 em{font:inherit;color:var(--yellow)}
.k-wrap{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px}
/* hero */
.k-hero{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:28px 0 36px;position:relative}
.k-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:34px}
.k-brand{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;font:700 12px "Inter Tight";letter-spacing:.08em}
.k-brand i{display:inline-block;width:12px;height:3px}
.k-lang{display:flex;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.k-lang button{all:unset;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;font:700 12px "Inter Tight";padding:7px 12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.k-lang button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
.k-kicker{font:700 12px "Inter Tight";letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--sky);text-transform:uppercase}
.k-kicker:after{content:"";display:block;width:28px;height:3px;background:var(--coral);margin-top:8px}
.k-h1{font:900 clamp(34px,9vw,58px)/1.02 "Inter Tight";letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:16px 0 10px}
[data-lang=ko] .k-h1{font-family:"Pretendard";font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.15}
.k-h1 em{font:italic 400 1.05em "Instrument Serif";color:var(--yellow);letter-spacing:0}
.k-lede{font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);max-width:34em}
.k-dots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(17,1fr);gap:5px;margin:28px 0 14px}
.k-dots>*{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);transition:background .4s,transform .4s}
.k-dots>.on{background:var(--yellow);transform:scale(1.08)}
.k-dots>.new{background:var(--coral)}
.k-count{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;font:900 40px "Inter Tight"}
.k-count small{font:500 14px "Inter Tight";color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
[data-lang=ko] .k-count small{font-family:Pretendard}
.k-upd{font-size:13px;color:var(--sky);margin-top:6px}
/* summary */
.k-sec{padding:34px 0 8px}
.k-h2{font:900 24px/1.15 "Inter Tight";margin:0 0 4px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
[data-lang=ko] .k-h2{font-family:Pretendard;font-weight:800}
.k-sub{font-size:14px;color:#56637a;margin:0 0 16px}
.k-five{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px}
.k-five li{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line);cursor:pointer}
.k-five b{font:900 15px "Inter Tight";color:var(--coral);min-width:34px}
.k-five strong{display:block;font-size:16px;line-height:1.3}
.k-five span{font-size:13.5px;color:#56637a;line-height:1.4}
/* filters */
.k-filters{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:4px 0 14px;scrollbar-width:none;position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--paper);z-index:3}
.k-filters::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.k-chip{all:unset;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;font:700 13px "Inter Tight";padding:8px 13px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff}
[data-lang=ko] .k-chip{font-family:Pretendard}
.k-chip[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
/* grid */
.k-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px}
@media(min-width:560px){.k-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
.k-card{all:unset;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;min-height:132px;border-radius:14px;padding:13px 13px 12px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line);position:relative}
.k-card .n{font:900 13px "Inter Tight";color:var(--blue)}
.k-card .t{font-weight:700;font-size:15px;line-height:1.28;margin-top:10px}
[data-lang=ko] .k-card .t{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.k-card .c{font:500 11px "Inter Tight";color:#7a8598;margin-top:10px;display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
[data-lang=ko] .k-card .c{font-family:Pretendard}
.k-card .pin{color:var(--blue)}
.k-card .badge{position:absolute;top:11px;right:11px;font:900 10px "Inter Tight";letter-spacing:.06em;color:#fff;background:var(--coral);padding:3px 6px;border-radius:5px}
.k-card.soon{background:transparent;border:1.5px dashed rgba(11,27,51,.18);box-shadow:none;cursor:default;min-height:72px}
.k-card.soon .t{color:#9aa3b2;font-weight:500;font-size:13px;margin-top:6px}
.k-more{all:unset;cursor:pointer;display:block;text-align:center;margin:14px auto 0;font:700 14px "Inter Tight";padding:12px 18px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff}
/* sheet */
.k-sheet{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;display:none}
.k-sheet.open{display:block}
.k-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(11,27,51,.5)}
.k-panel{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;max-height:88vh;overflow:auto;background:#fff;border-radius:20px 20px 0 0;padding:10px 20px 28px;max-width:720px;margin:0 auto;animation:up .25s ease}
@keyframes up{from{transform:translateY(30px);opacity:0}}
.k-grab{width:40px;height:4px;border-radius:4px;background:#d5d9e0;margin:0 auto 14px}
.k-panel .n{font:900 14px "Inter Tight";color:var(--blue)}
.k-panel h3{font:900 26px/1.15 "Inter Tight";margin:8px 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
[data-lang=ko] .k-panel h3{font-family:Pretendard;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.k-panel p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 14px}
.k-tip{background:#FFF6E3;border-left:4px solid var(--yellow);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:14px}
.k-tip b{display:block;font:900 11px "Inter Tight";letter-spacing:.1em;color:#a26b00;margin-bottom:3px}
.k-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px}
.k-btn{all:unset;cursor:pointer;font:700 14px "Inter Tight";padding:11px 15px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
[data-lang=ko] .k-btn{font-family:Pretendard}
.k-btn.ghost{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.k-src{font-size:12.5px;color:#6b7588;line-height:1.5;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px}
.k-src b{color:var(--ink)}
.k-close{all:unset;cursor:pointer;position:absolute;right:14px;top:12px;font:700 22px/1 "Inter Tight";color:#8a93a3;padding:6px}
/* log + footer */
.k-log{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}
.k-log li{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.k-log time{font:700 13px "Inter Tight";color:var(--blue);min-width:62px}
.k-ask{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:22px 20px;margin:30px 0 10px}
.k-ask h3{font:900 21px "Inter Tight";margin:0 0 6px}
[data-lang=ko] .k-ask h3{font-family:Pretendard;font-weight:800}
.k-ask p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;margin:0 0 14px}
.k-ask .k-btn{background:var(--yellow);color:var(--ink)}
.k-foot{font-size:12px;color:#7a8598;padding:20px 0 40px;line-height:1.6}

/* Full-screen mode (YunShik 2026-11-20, same as How to Seoul map / AI-cheating article).
   Google-injected body children (ad-block notice, ads, iframes) are never hidden: hiding them caused the invisible scroll lock. */
html:has(#k101),body:has(#k101){background:#F6F3EC!important}
body.gs-on{margin:0!important;padding:0!important}
body.gs-on>*:not(#k101):not(script):not(style):not(#ghost-portal-root):not([id^=ghost-]):not(ins):not(iframe):not([class*=fc-]):not([class*=google]){display:none!important}
#k101 .k-h1{margin-top:0}
/* 101 x map cross-promo (2026-11-21) */
#k101 .k-countrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
#k101 .k-mapdot{flex:none;width:68px;height:68px;border-radius:50%;background:#F0604C;border:3px solid #FFC86B;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.3);position:relative;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
#k101 .k-mapdot b{font-size:20px;line-height:1}#k101 .k-mapdot span{font:800 11px/1.1 "Inter Tight",Pretendard,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-top:3px}
#k101 .k-mapdot:hover{transform:scale(1.06)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){#k101 .k-mapdot::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-3px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #FFC86B;animation:kxp 2.2s ease-out infinite}}
@keyframes kxp{0%{transform:scale(1);opacity:.9}100%{transform:scale(1.45);opacity:0}}
#k101 .k-mapban{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin:4px 0 8px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:16px;background:#0B1B33;color:#fff;text-decoration:none}
#k101 .k-mapban b.c{flex:none;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:#F0604C;border:3px solid #FFC86B;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:22px}
#k101 .k-mapban span{display:block;font-weight:800;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.3}
#k101 .k-mapban small{display:block;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.4;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75);margin-top:3px}
#k101 .k-mapban i{margin-left:auto;font-style:normal;font-size:22px;color:#FFC86B}
#k101 .k-side{display:none}
#k101 .k-fb{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin:28px 0 0;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:16px;background:#1877F2;color:#fff;text-decoration:none}
#k101 .k-fb b.c{flex:none;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;color:#1877F2;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:900 28px/1 Arial,sans-serif}
#k101 .k-fb span{display:block;font-weight:800;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.3}#k101 .k-fb small{display:block;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.4;opacity:.9;margin-top:3px}
#k101 .k-fb i{margin-left:auto;font-style:normal;font-size:22px}
#k101 .k-fbdot{background:#1877F2;border-color:#fff}#k101 .k-fbdot b{font:900 28px/1 Arial,sans-serif}#k101 .k-fbdot span{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.02em}#k101 .k-fbdot::after{border-color:#fff!important}
#k101 .k-fbside b.c{background:#1877F2!important;border-color:#9CC3FF!important;font:900 38px/1 Arial,sans-serif!important}#k101 .k-fbside span{color:#1877F2!important}
@media (min-width:1200px){#k101 .k-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:6px;position:fixed;top:120px;left:calc(50% - 360px - 236px);width:200px;padding:18px 14px;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;color:#0B1B33;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(11,27,51,.16);z-index:5}
#k101 .k-side b.c{width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;background:#F0604C;border:3px solid #FFC86B;color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:26px;line-height:1;margin-bottom:4px}
#k101 .k-side b.c em{font:800 11px "Inter Tight",Pretendard,sans-serif;font-style:normal;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-top:4px}
#k101 .k-side strong{font-size:15px}#k101 .k-side small{font-size:12.5px;color:#56627a;line-height:1.4}
#k101 .k-side span{margin-top:4px;font-weight:800;font-size:13px;color:#F0604C}
#k101 .k-side:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}}
#k101 .k-by{font-size:12.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin-top:6px}
#k-cmt{margin-top:28px}#k-cmt:empty{display:none}
#k-cmt .comments-section{padding:0!important;margin:0!important;max-width:none!important}
#k-cmt .comments-wrap{background:#fff!important;border-radius:14px!important;padding:18px!important;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(11,27,51,.12)!important}
#k-cmt h2,#k-cmt h3,#k-cmt p,#k-cmt span{color:#0B1B33!important}
.k-ad{margin:28px auto 0;text-align:center}.k-ad p{font-size:11px;color:#8a93a3;margin:0 0 4px}
.k-ad ins{display:block;width:100%;height:280px;margin:0 auto}
@media(max-width:600px){.k-ad ins{width:320px;height:100px}}
.k-dots>a,.k-dots>span{display:block;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.k-dots>a:hover,.k-dots>span:hover{transform:scale(1.35)!important;background:var(--sky)}
.k-dots>.on:hover{background:#fff}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.k-dots>.new{animation:kpulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}}
@keyframes kpulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(240,96,76,.7)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(240,96,76,0)}}
.k-home{text-align:center;margin:18px 0 8px;font-size:14px}.k-home a{color:var(--blue)!important;text-decoration:underline}
#k101 [hidden]{display:none!important}
#k101 a{color:inherit}
#k101 .k-btn{color:#fff}#k101 .k-btn.ghost{color:var(--ink)}#k101 .k-ask .k-btn{color:var(--ink)}
.k-lang a{all:unset;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;font:700 12px "Inter Tight","Pretendard";padding:7px 12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
.k-lang a[aria-current]{background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
#k101 .k-lang a[aria-current]{color:#0B1B33}
.k-answer{font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:16px 18px;margin:0 0 26px;box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line)}
.k-five li{padding:0}.k-five a{all:unset;cursor:pointer;display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;padding:14px 16px;width:100%}
.k-card{text-decoration:none}
.k-story{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;margin:0 0 8px;box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line);scroll-margin-top:70px}
.k-story summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:baseline;padding:14px 16px}
.k-story summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.k-story summary h3{font:700 16px/1.35 "Inter Tight"!important;margin:0!important;flex:1}
[data-lang=ko] .k-story summary h3{font-family:Pretendard!important}
.k-story summary:after{content:"+";font:700 20px/1 "Inter Tight";color:#8a93a3}
.k-story[open] summary:after{content:"−"}
.k-story[open] summary{display:none}
.k-story-in{padding:16px 18px 16px}
.k-story .n,.k-panel .n{font:900 13px "Inter Tight";color:var(--blue)}
.k-story h3{font:900 21px/1.2 "Inter Tight";margin:6px 0 10px}
[data-lang=ko] .k-story h3{font-family:Pretendard;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.k-story p{font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 12px}
.k-story:target{outline:3px solid var(--yellow)}
.k-fig{margin:0 0 12px}.k-fig img{width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:10px;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover}.k-fig figcaption{font-size:11.5px;color:#7a8598;margin-top:4px}
.k-send{background:#FFF6E3;border-radius:16px;padding:18px;margin:26px 0 0;display:grid;gap:6px}.k-send b{font-size:17px}.k-send span{font-size:14px;color:#56637a}.k-send .k-btn{justify-self:start;margin-top:6px}
.k-rel{padding-left:18px;line-height:1.9;font-size:15px}.k-rel a{color:var(--blue)!important;text-decoration:underline}
.k-sh,.k-sheet-body h3{font:900 26px/1.15 "Inter Tight";margin:8px 0 12px}
[data-lang=ko] .k-sh,[data-lang=ko] .k-sheet-body h3{font-family:Pretendard;font-weight:800}
.k-sheet-body p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 14px}
/* medium stories (2026-11-23) */
#k101 .k-mid{display:grid;gap:12px;margin:14px 0 4px}
#k101 .k-tbl{overflow-x:auto}#k101 .k-tbl table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.4;margin:0}
#k101 .k-tbl th{font-size:12.5px;color:#5d6779;font-weight:700;text-align:left;padding:7px 8px;border-bottom:2px solid #E3DED4;background:none}
#k101 .k-tbl td{padding:9px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #EEE9E0;vertical-align:top;background:none}
#k101 .k-tbl td:first-child{font-weight:700}
#k101 .k-steps{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;counter-reset:ks;display:grid;gap:8px}
#k101 .k-steps li{counter-increment:ks;display:flex;gap:10px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;margin:0}
#k101 .k-steps li:before{content:counter(ks);flex:none;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:#0B1B33;color:#fff;font:800 12.5px/24px "Inter Tight",Pretendard,sans-serif;text-align:center;margin-top:1px}
#k101 .k-note{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;margin:0;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:#F3F0EA}
#k101 .k-say{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;background:#FFF6E0}
#k101 .k-say button{all:unset;cursor:pointer;flex:none;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:#FFC86B;font-size:19px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
#k101 .k-say button.on{background:#F0604C}
#k101 .k-say b{display:block;font:800 18px/1.3 Pretendard,sans-serif}#k101 .k-say span{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#5d6779;line-height:1.4;margin-top:2px}
#k101 .k-vid{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#0B1B33}
#k101 .k-vid img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;opacity:.85}
#k101 .k-vid button{all:unset;cursor:pointer;position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
#k101 .k-vid button span{width:62px;height:62px;border-radius:50%;background:#F0604C;color:#fff;font-size:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.35);padding-left:4px;box-sizing:border-box}
#k101 .k-vid iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0}
#k101 .k-tel{justify-self:start}
#k101 .k-ill{margin:0}#k101 .k-ill svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;border-radius:12px}#k101 .k-ill figcaption{font-size:11px;color:#8a93a3;margin-top:3px}
#k101 .k-chart{margin:0}#k101 .k-chart figcaption{font-weight:800;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:4px}
#k101 .k-chart svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
#k101 .k-cleg{font-size:12px;color:#5d6779;margin-top:2px}#k101 .k-cleg:empty{display:none}
#k101 .k-csrc{font-size:11.5px;color:#8a93a3;margin-top:2px}
#k101 .k-live{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:#0B1B33;color:#fff}
#k101 .k-live b{font:800 21px/1.1 "Inter Tight",Pretendard,sans-serif;color:#FFC86B;white-space:nowrap}
#k101 .k-live span{font-size:14px;line-height:1.35}#k101 .k-live small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin-top:2px}

#k101 .g-back{display:inline-block;margin:0 0 10px;font:700 13px/1 Pretendard,"Inter Tight",sans-serif;color:#FFC86B!important;text-decoration:none}
#k101 .g-meta{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);margin-top:8px}
#k101 .g-areas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:6px 0 10px}
#k101 .g-area{all:unset;cursor:pointer;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:999px;border:2px solid #0B1B33;font:700 14px/1 Pretendard,"Inter Tight",sans-serif;color:#0B1B33;background:#fff}
#k101 .g-area[aria-pressed=true]{background:#0B1B33;color:#fff}
#k101 .g-rec{background:#E9F7EF;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 16px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.55}
#k101 .g-rec b{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#2E9E62;margin-bottom:4px}

<div class="k-kicker">101 · #002 · Getting around</div><h1 class="k-h1">The story behind Seoul's subway transfer music</h1>
<div class="g-meta">Updated 2026-11-24 · Checked against National Gugak Center and news reports</div></div></header>
<div class="k-wrap">
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">30-second answer</h2><p class="k-answer">That cheerful five-second tune on Seoul subway lines 1 to 8 means "transfer station ahead." It's "Pungnyeon" (good harvest), a gayageum piece built on an old Gyeonggi folk song. Riders picked it in a 2022 public vote, and in 2026 the National Gugak Center rearranged it so it stands out from train noise.</p></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">From bird calls to a folk song</h2><div class="g-box"><p>Seoul's transfer signal has changed many times. Early on, each operator chose its own: lines 1 to 4 used electronic beeps and bird whistles, and lines 5 to 8 played Vivaldi. Korean music arrived only in 2009.</p><div class="k-mid"><div class="k-tbl"><table><thead><tr><th>When</th><th>What played</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Before 2009</td><td>Beeps and bird whistles (lines 1–4), Vivaldi (lines 5–8)</td></tr><tr><td>2009</td><td>"Eolssiguya" by Kim Baek-chan on lines 1–4, to promote Korean culture</td></tr><tr><td>2012</td><td>Lines 5–8 switch to "Eolssiguya" too</td></tr><tr><td>Jan 2023</td><td>"Pungnyeon" by Park Kyung-hoon replaces it after a public vote</td></tr><tr><td>2026</td><td>"Pungnyeon" rearranged with flutes, fiddle and dulcimer</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">Riders chose it: the 2022 vote</h2><div class="g-box"><p>After 14 years of "Eolssiguya," Seoul Metro ran a two-week online vote in October 2022. The National Gugak Center offered five pieces for free. "Pungnyeon" won with 26.53% of the vote and started playing in January 2023.</p></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">"A good harvest has come!"</h2><div class="g-box"><p>"Pungnyeon" keeps the main line of the Gyeonggi folk song "Pungnyeonga": pungnyeoni watne, "a good harvest has come." Composer Park Kyung-hoon turned it into a simple, bright tune in 4/4 time for gayageum (a Korean zither) with piano, bass and drums.</p><div class="k-mid"><div class="k-say"><button type="button" data-say="풍년이 왔네" aria-label="Listen: 풍년이 왔네">🔊</button><div><b lang="ko">풍년이 왔네</b><span>pungnyeoni watne · A good harvest has come!</span></div></div></div></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">Why it was rearranged in 2026</h2><div class="g-box"><p>Subway staff and riders said the tune was hard to hear. The National Gugak Center found that its sound sat in the same frequency range as the noise and vibration of a moving train. So it studied which Korean instruments cut through and rebuilt the piece around four of them.</p><div class="k-mid"><div class="k-tbl"><table><thead><tr><th>Instrument</th><th>What it is</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Daegeum 대금</td><td>Large bamboo flute played sideways</td></tr><tr><td>Sogeum 소금</td><td>Small, high bamboo flute</td></tr><tr><td>Haegeum 해금</td><td>Two-string fiddle held upright</td></tr><tr><td>Yanggeum 양금</td><td>Hammered dulcimer with metal strings</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">Bonus: the subway tune went EDM</h2><div class="g-box"><p>In July 2023 the National Gugak Center released "Pungnyeon (Beatbox Remix)" on streaming services: traditional singing, a 25-string gayageum and a beatboxer, with a cash-register sound as the modern "good harvest."</p></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">Hear the instruments up close</h2><div class="g-box"><p>The Gugak Museum at the National Gugak Center in Seocho, next to Seoul Arts Center, shows Korean instruments and has a hands-on room where you can try the gayageum and janggu drum. Admission is free.</p><div class="k-tip"><b>FRIEND TIP</b><span>It's closed on Mondays. Nearest subway: Nambu Bus Terminal Station (Line 3).</span></div></div></section>

<div class="k-kicker">101 · #002 · 도착·교통</div><h1 class="k-h1">서울 지하철 환승 음악 이야기: 새소리에서 국악까지</h1>
<div class="g-meta">업데이트 2026-11-24 · 국립국악원 발표와 언론 보도로 확인</div></div></header>
<div class="k-wrap">
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">30초 답</h2><p class="k-answer">서울 지하철 1~8호선에서 5초쯤 흐르는 신나는 국악은 '곧 환승역'이라는 신호예요. 곡 이름은 '풍년'이고, 경기민요 '풍년가'를 바탕으로 한 가야금 곡이에요. 2022년 시민 투표로 골랐고, 2026년 국립국악원이 열차 소음 속에서도 잘 들리게 다시 편곡했어요.</p></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">새소리에서 국악까지</h2><div class="g-box"><p>서울 지하철 환승 신호는 여러 번 바뀌었어요. 처음엔 운영 회사마다 달라서 1~4호선은 전자음과 새소리, 5~8호선은 비발디가 나왔어요. 국악이 들어온 건 2009년이에요.</p><div class="k-mid"><div class="k-tbl"><table><thead><tr><th>언제</th><th>무엇이 나왔나</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>2009년 전</td><td>전자음·새소리(1~4호선), 비발디(5~8호선)</td></tr><tr><td>2009년</td><td>김백찬 '얼씨구야', 한국 문화를 알리려고 1~4호선에</td></tr><tr><td>2012년</td><td>5~8호선도 '얼씨구야'로 통일</td></tr><tr><td>2023년 1월</td><td>시민 투표로 고른 박경훈 '풍년'으로 교체</td></tr><tr><td>2026년</td><td>'풍년'을 대금·해금·양금·소금으로 새로 편곡</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">시민이 골랐어요: 2022년 투표</h2><div class="g-box"><p>'얼씨구야'를 14년 쓴 뒤, 서울교통공사가 2022년 10월 2주 동안 온라인 투표를 열었어요. 국립국악원이 무료로 내놓은 후보곡 5곡 가운데 '풍년'이 26.53%로 1위를 했고, 2023년 1월부터 나오기 시작했어요.</p></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">"풍년이 왔네"</h2><div class="g-box"><p>'풍년'은 경기민요 '풍년가'의 대표 가락 "풍년이 왔네, 풍년이 왔네"를 그대로 살렸어요. 작곡가 박경훈이 이를 4분의 4박자의 단순하고 밝은 곡으로 바꿨고, 가야금에 피아노·베이스·드럼을 더했어요.</p><div class="k-mid"><div class="k-say"><button type="button" data-say="풍년이 왔네" aria-label="듣기: 풍년이 왔네">🔊</button><div><b lang="ko">풍년이 왔네</b><span>pungnyeoni watne · 풍년이 왔네!</span></div></div></div></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">2026년에 왜 다시 편곡했을까</h2><div class="g-box"><p>역 직원과 승객들이 '잘 안 들린다'고 했어요. 국립국악원이 분석해 보니 곡의 소리 대역이 달리는 열차의 소음·진동과 겹쳤어요. 그래서 소음을 뚫고 들리는 국악기를 골라 네 악기 중심으로 다시 만들었어요.</p><div class="k-mid"><div class="k-tbl"><table><thead><tr><th>악기</th><th>어떤 악기</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>대금</td><td>옆으로 부는 큰 대나무 피리</td></tr><tr><td>소금</td><td>작고 높은 소리의 대나무 피리</td></tr><tr><td>해금</td><td>세워서 켜는 두 줄 현악기</td></tr><tr><td>양금</td><td>쇠줄을 채로 치는 현악기</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">보너스: 환승 음악이 EDM이 됐어요</h2><div class="g-box"><p>2023년 7월 국립국악원은 음원 '풍년(비트박스 리믹스)'을 냈어요. 남도소리·서도소리에 25현 가야금과 비트박스를 섞었고, 요즘의 '풍년'을 계산대 소리로 표현했어요.</p></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">악기를 직접 들어 보려면</h2><div class="g-box"><p>서초동 국립국악원 안의 국악박물관(예술의전당 옆)에서 국악기를 보고, 체험실에서 가야금과 장구를 직접 쳐 볼 수 있어요. 관람료는 무료예요.</p><div class="k-tip"><b>친구 팁</b><span>월요일은 쉬어요. 가까운 역은 3호선 남부터미널역이에요.</span></div></div></section>

<div class="k-kicker">101 · #002 · Moverse</div><h1 class="k-h1">La historia de la música de transbordo del metro de Seúl</h1>
<div class="g-meta">Actualizado 2026-11-24 · Verificado con el Centro Nacional de Gugak y la prensa</div></div></header>
<div class="k-wrap">
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">Respuesta en 30 segundos</h2><p class="k-answer">Esa melodía alegre de unos cinco segundos en las líneas 1 a 8 del metro de Seúl significa "próxima estación de transbordo". Se llama "Pungnyeon" (buena cosecha), una pieza de gayageum basada en una canción popular de Gyeonggi. Los pasajeros la eligieron en una votación en 2022, y en 2026 el Centro Nacional de Gugak la rearregló para que se oiga por encima del ruido del tren.</p></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">De pájaros a una canción popular</h2><div class="g-box"><p>La señal de transbordo de Seúl ha cambiado muchas veces. Al principio cada operador elegía la suya: las líneas 1 a 4 usaban pitidos y cantos de pájaros, y las 5 a 8, Vivaldi. La música coreana llegó recién en 2009.</p><div class="k-mid"><div class="k-tbl"><table><thead><tr><th>Cuándo</th><th>Qué sonaba</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Antes de 2009</td><td>Pitidos y pájaros (líneas 1–4), Vivaldi (líneas 5–8)</td></tr><tr><td>2009</td><td>"Eolssiguya" de Kim Baek-chan en las líneas 1–4, para promover la cultura coreana</td></tr><tr><td>2012</td><td>Las líneas 5–8 también pasan a "Eolssiguya"</td></tr><tr><td>Ene. 2023</td><td>"Pungnyeon" de Park Kyung-hoon la reemplaza tras una votación</td></tr><tr><td>2026</td><td>"Pungnyeon" con nuevo arreglo de flautas, violín y salterio</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">Lo eligieron los pasajeros: la votación de 2022</h2><div class="g-box"><p>Tras 14 años de "Eolssiguya", Seoul Metro abrió una votación en línea de dos semanas en octubre de 2022. El Centro Nacional de Gugak ofreció cinco piezas gratis. "Pungnyeon" ganó con el 26.53 % de los votos y empezó a sonar en enero de 2023.</p></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">"¡Ha llegado una buena cosecha!"</h2><div class="g-box"><p>"Pungnyeon" conserva la frase principal de la canción popular de Gyeonggi "Pungnyeonga": pungnyeoni watne, "ha llegado una buena cosecha". El compositor Park Kyung-hoon la convirtió en una melodía simple y alegre en 4/4 para gayageum (una cítara coreana) con piano, bajo y batería.</p><div class="k-mid"><div class="k-say"><button type="button" data-say="풍년이 왔네" aria-label="Escuchar: 풍년이 왔네">🔊</button><div><b lang="ko">풍년이 왔네</b><span>pungnyeoni watne · ¡Ha llegado una buena cosecha!</span></div></div></div></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">Por qué se rearregló en 2026</h2><div class="g-box"><p>El personal del metro y los pasajeros decían que costaba oírla. El Centro Nacional de Gugak vio que su sonido estaba en las mismas frecuencias que el ruido y la vibración del tren. Así que estudió qué instrumentos coreanos se oyen por encima y rehízo la pieza con cuatro de ellos.</p><div class="k-mid"><div class="k-tbl"><table><thead><tr><th>Instrumento</th><th>Qué es</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Daegeum 대금</td><td>Flauta grande de bambú, tocada de lado</td></tr><tr><td>Sogeum 소금</td><td>Flauta de bambú pequeña y aguda</td></tr><tr><td>Haegeum 해금</td><td>Violín de dos cuerdas tocado en vertical</td></tr><tr><td>Yanggeum 양금</td><td>Salterio de cuerdas metálicas, tocado con macillos</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">Extra: la melodía se volvió EDM</h2><div class="g-box"><p>En julio de 2023 el Centro Nacional de Gugak lanzó "Pungnyeon (Beatbox Remix)" en plataformas de streaming: canto tradicional, un gayageum de 25 cuerdas y un beatboxer, con el sonido de una caja registradora como la "buena cosecha" moderna.</p></div></section>
<section class="k-sec"><h2 class="k-h2">Escucha los instrumentos de cerca</h2><div class="g-box"><p>El Museo del Gugak, dentro del Centro Nacional de Gugak en Seocho (junto al Seoul Arts Center), muestra instrumentos coreanos y tiene una sala donde puedes probar el gayageum y el tambor janggu. La entrada es gratis.</p><div class="k-tip"><b>CONSEJO DE AMIGO</b><span>Cierra los lunes. Metro más cercano: estación Nambu Bus Terminal (línea 3).</span></div></div></section>
